title: Analysis code for: Culture-proven infection is associated with lower total serum bilirubin in neonates: a retrospective cohort study with genetic and transcriptomic triangulation
description:
Analysis code (51 Python scripts, 7 R scripts and the 7 CSV files of plotting input data) reproducing every number, table and figure reported in the manuscript. The code covers three evidence layers: two neonatal clinical cohorts (MIMIC-IV v1.0 and MIMIC-III v1.4); genetic analyses comprising cis-pQTL Mendelian randomisation and colocalisation for IL6R and the HAMP locus; and human hepatocyte transcriptomes from GEO.

No patient-level data are redistributed. MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV are access-controlled on PhysioNet and require credentialed access together with acceptance of the data use agreement; the clinical scripts expect a local PostgreSQL instance holding the MIMIC schemas. All other inputs (GEO, FinnGen Release 12, GWAS Catalog, Ensembl) are public, while OpenGWAS requires a free token supplied through the OGWAS_JWT environment variable.

See 00_Code_Index_and_Run_Order.md for the script-by-script index, the recommended run order, the runtime pitfalls, and a table mapping each manuscript number to its source script. The development repository is at https://github.com/ruijin1/IL6_HEPCIDIN.
